getting so many compliments each day, it has been an amazing ride.

feel much more energetic and healthy, this has turned my life around, and all it took was 12 months of discipline.

comment: Going from 107kg to 76kg in a year is a serious lifestyle change, not just a weight loss milestone. The part people often underestimate is learning to trust yourself again after months of keeping promises to yourself. Did you notice your mindset changing before the physical results showed up, or did the confidence come mostly after the transformation?
